# Lithium Downstream Summit 2026

> A two-day in-person summit in Melbourne, Australia focused on lithium refining, project bankability, capital deployment, and battery supply chain security. Organised by iQ-Hub.

- Location: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

- Date: December 2026 (exact dates published on the Program page)

- Format: In-person conference

- Industry: Critical Minerals and Battery Supply Chain

## Key Pages

- Home (/): Event overview, themes, and highlights

- Agenda (/agenda-page): Full event agenda and session details (requires email signup and verification)

- Who Should Attend (/who-should-attend): Target audience and delegate benefits

- Featured Speakers (/featured-speakers): Confirmed speaker lineup

- Sponsors (/sponsors): Sponsorship partners and exhibitors

- Venue (/venue): Location and logistics

- News (/news): Industry news and event updates

- Register (/booking): Delegate registration and booking
